title: Associate Data Analyst
must_have: 1+ years of experience in data science
text:
Associate Data Analyst
Zanskar Labs | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a associate data analyst to join our data science team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Data Visualization
- SQL
- Machine Learning
- Feature Engineering
- Pandas
- 1+ years of experience in data science

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- PyTorch
- Python
- Tableau
- Airflow

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive churn reduction programme with measurable outcomes.
- Drive fraud screening upgrade with measurable outcomes.
- Drive customer segmentation refresh with measurable outcomes.
